{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA rows: revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_rows = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Remove QA rows from the dataset
sales_clean = sales.drop(qa_rows.index)

# Verify that QA rows are removed
print(f'Number of QA rows removed: {len(qa_rows)}')
print(f'New dataset shape: {sales_clean.shape}')

# Check if any QA rows remain in the cleaned data
remaining_qa = sales_clean[sales_clean['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
print(f'QA rows remaining: {len(remaining_qa)}')"}
